items.title: Kotak Mahindra Bank's Q2 net profit jumps 26% to Rs 5,645 crore
items.description: The company had reported a net profit of Rs 5,487.06 crore in the June quarter of the current financial year.

items.title: ICRA keeps eMudhra ratings unchanged after certificate security lapse, warns of reputational fallout
items.description: The rating agency, in an update dated October 23, reaffirmed [ICRA]A (Stable)/[ICRA]A1 on eMudhra's Rs 35 crore of unallocated credit limits.

items.title: Barclays is latest to redirect spending toward AI as it trims its workforce

items.title: Jio IPO: Firm set to join India’s top 3 listed companies, Reliance Group to lead by market cap
